result.title: Governed-intake release: one source of truth here, consumers read floating latest; delete vendored copies, pins, repin flow and pin checks
result.body:
<!-- governed-work-unit-key: sha256:e2ef0fdd4496c9e6e7dee52a1c91ca268ea54a1a8edebd82440a8efd701a1f73 -->

## Decision (Spencer, 2026-10-03)
The governed-intake release has one source of truth: this repo. Consumers (agent-orchestrator, cli-wrappers, code) read the **latest** release from `.github`. That means no pinned releases, no committed or vendored copies, and no repin step.

This replaces the pinned-consumption criterion in #13 ("consumers name the .github producer commit/digest and fail closed on unsupported/stale release"). The rest of #13, a single account-wide form with no local template overrides, still stands.

## Ownership boundary
- **The producer** owns only its own contract and its own tests, optionally with one example integration test. `.github` does not know about, enumerate, or test its consumers.
- **Each consumer** is responsible for adapting to the latest release and for its own tests against it.

## Pin machinery to remove (inventory from code search, 2026-10-03)
- **Pins at revision 22:**
  - `cli-wrappers/contracts/governed-intake-producer.pin.json`
  - `agent-orchestrator/contracts/governed-intake-current-release.pin.json`
  - `code/tools/work-spine/governed-intake-current-release.pin.json`
- **Vendored copies:**
  - `cli-wrappers/src/lib/generated/governed-intake/` and `.../governed-intake-bundle/` (including `manifest.json`, `verify.ts/js`)
  - `cli-wrappers/src/lib/generated/governed-intake.ts`
  - `code/contracts/generated/governed-intake/` (`manifest.json`, `verify.ts/js`)
  - `agent-orchestrator/types/governed-intake-release/`
- **`payloadDigest` / revision pin checks:**
  - `code/tools/checks/repo/integrity/cli-wrappers/check-governed-intake-pin-drift.ts`
  - `code/contracts/governed-intake-producer-release.ts` (+ test)
  - `agent-orchestrator/lib/governed-intake/producer-release.ts` (+ test)
  - `code/skills/select-ready-gh-issue/producer-binding.ts`
  - the digest checks in `code/tools/github-mcp-worker/src/triage-checklist-state.ts`
- **Catalog freshness:** `agent-orchestrator/lib/catalog-freshness.ts` (+ test), the governed-intake part.
- **Producer-release repin flow:**
  - `code/tools/reconcile/governed-intake/producer-currentness.ts`
  - `producer-lag-detector.ts`
  - `producer-release-fixtures.ts`
- **Sync and publish scripts:**
  - `cli-wrappers/scripts/sync-governed-intake-contract.ts`
  - `cli-wrappers/scripts/publish-governed-intake-bundle-dist.ts`
- **Docs and tests that describe pinning:** `code/docs/guides/issue-intake.md`, `cli-wrappers/test/governed-intake-bundle-dist.test.ts`, `cli-wrappers/test/governed-intake-body.test.ts`.

## Acceptance
- None of the three consumers commits any governed-intake payload, pin file, or digest/revision pin check. A fleet check fails if one reappears.
- Each consumer loads the latest release from `.github` at runtime/build. Publishing a new release reaches all three with no consumer commit.
- `.github`'s tests cover only its own contract, plus at most one example integration test. No consumer list or consumer tests live in `.github`.
- Each consumer has its own tests against the latest release.
- The repin flow, pin-drift checks, catalog-freshness gate for intake, and sync scripts are deleted, not just disabled.

## Related
- #13: superseded on pinning.
- #33: alias removal; drop the repin steps there.
- #32 / #36: next revision.
- code#6453: consumer rebind.
- cli-wrappers#1402: the runtime copy misses its import closure. Reading latest removes the copy entirely.

## Durable fix and acceptance

- None of the three consumers commits any governed-intake payload, pin file, or digest/revision pin check. A fleet check fails if one reappears.
- Each consumer loads the latest release from `.github` at runtime/build. Publishing a new release reaches all three with no consumer commit.
- `.github`'s tests cover only its own contract, plus at most one example integration test. No consumer list or consumer tests live in `.github`.
- Each consumer has its own tests against the latest release.
- The repin flow, pin-drift checks, catalog-freshness gate for intake, and sync scripts are deleted, not just disabled.

## Triage checklist
<!-- governed-triage-checklist: revision=22 -->
<!-- This checkbox block is the current triage-state SSOT. Check an item only after current evidence satisfies it. Do not delete or rename item markers. -->
<!-- governed-triage-item: canonical-flow -->
- [x] **Canonical flow**: Use `skills/gh-issue-triage-sweep/SKILL.md`. Keep discovery/orchestration in that skill and selected-collection adjudication in `gh-issue-audit`; do not recreate either procedure in issue prose.
<!-- governed-triage-item: value-direction -->
- [x] **Value + direction evidence**: Decide current value and direction from live sources. Record `direction-checked-at: <ISO-8601 UTC>` in the idempotent triage receipt, bound to the issue's governed work-unit key and current checklist revision. Direction evidence expires after 3 days. AO #8570 owns runtime stale-evidence re-pend / pickup refusal; Code records the contract and evidence but does not pretend its docs are the actuator.
<!-- governed-triage-item: fix-owner-responsibility -->
- [x] **Fix-owner + responsibility**: Resolve fix ownership from the current FleetRegistryReleaseV1 and repository charter evidence. Reuse a prior high-confidence ownership receipt for an existing issue while its durable outcome, repository, relevant scope, and governing charter identity are unchanged. Reroute new work, moves/transfers, cross-repo expansion, ambiguous ownership, charter changes, and catch-all `code`/`agent-orchestrator` cases. An obvious deterministic single-owner result does not require a model seat; use routed judgment only for genuine ambiguity.
<!-- governed-triage-item: dedup-queue-synergy -->
- [x] **Dedup + queue synergy**: Apply progressive same-class dedupe. Search open work in the resolved owner first and stop when the canonical owner is established. Inspect pending WorkProjection/plan state only when implementation overlap is plausible; search closed history only for regression/prior-fix evidence or when open search is inconclusive; inspect sibling repos only for shared/cross-repo surfaces. Reuse a fresh synergy receipt while issue class, owner, and material scope are unchanged. Never create a parallel implementation track when canonical work already owns the outcome.
<!-- governed-triage-item: scope-decomposition -->
- [x] **Scope + decomposition**: Resolve work shape before assigning final attributes. Record exactly one current disposition from the canonical triage policy: ordinary leaf (`decomp-not-needed`, low/medium), qualified atomic-high leaf (`decomp-atomic` + `effort:high` with independent confirmation), or tracking parent (`decomp` + `epic` with a validated child graph). Unresolved, unknown, or unqualified evidence stays pending. Child triage does not wait for a parent completion stamp. Do not require `decomp-in-progress`. Reuse `evaluateTriagePolicy` and the effort rubric in `contracts/governed-intake-triage-policy.v1.json`; do not copy a second rubric or treat checked boxes as qualified identity. Bind the assessment to the actual server-fetched issue identity and normalized scope using the producer-owned identity API; matching caller-supplied identities or structural checkbox checks alone never establish semantic completion.
<!-- governed-triage-item: priority-work-dimensions -->
- [x] **Priority + work dimensions**: Apply the complete priority triplet, exactly one honest effort, and exactly one lawful tier from the live priority/work-spine policies. Effort definitions and examples come from the canonical governed-intake triage policy, not private calibration caps. Missing or unclear effort is unknown, not low. Certified atomic-high remains high. Never self-admit P0.
<!-- governed-triage-item: verify-human-required -->
- [x] **Verify + human-required fences**: `tier:auto` executable leaves require a bounded scoped verification contract before an implementation writer starts, but completed triage does not require the issue body to already contain `## Verify`. Reuse a current scoped named-file `## Verify` fence when present; otherwise the implementation commissioning path derives and persists/backfills the verification contract before dispatch. If safe scoped verification cannot yet be derived, the leaf waits on verification clarification at implementation preflight rather than remaining untriaged. Tracking parents do not inherit child Verify, host, or substrate requirements. `human-required` is adjudicated through `stamp-human-required` and requires the current tradeoffs contract. A verification-contract derivation allowance is never blanket body-rewrite authority.
<!-- governed-triage-item: cloud-runnable -->
- [x] **Cloud vs local execution**: Assess the implementation stage using the [cloud-readiness criteria](https://github.com/spencer-shadley/code/blob/master/docs/architecture/cloud-local-executor-routing.md#cloud-ready-issue-triage). Before triage can complete, apply exactly one execution-substrate label: `cloud-ready` when implementation can run in an authorized provider-hosted environment, or `local-required` when implementation needs a fleet/local machine. Never leave both or neither on a completed triage. Record `ready` or `not-ready`, a short reason, and any separately required local verification/rollout in the existing triage receipt; an unresolved or `unknown` assessment stays untriaged. If one exact host is required, also apply its machine label. Tracking parents do not inherit every child host or substrate requirement.
<!-- governed-triage-item: disposition-effect-authority -->
- [x] **Disposition != effect authority**: Adjudicate close / keep / strengthen / residualize / consolidate / move semantics from evidence. Execute close, move, substantive rewrite, or another restricted GitHub effect only when the current role is authorized; otherwise hand the adjudicated effect to the authorized executor with a durable receipt. Do not keep zombie work alive merely because the current seat cannot execute the terminal effect.
<!-- governed-triage-item: higher-intelligence-handoff -->
- [x] **Higher-intelligence handoff**: `effort:high`, unclear effort, `human-required`, material remaining uncertainty, or programme-shaped work uses qualified higher-intelligence assessment inside triage. Scope and decomposition are the earlier `scope-decomposition` obligation. Confirmed tracking parents stay tracking-only. Unresolved delegation is not completed triage. The triage role does not mint implementation plans or commission implementation writers.
<!-- governed-triage-item: github-effects-quota -->
- [x] **GitHub effects + quota**: Use the governed GitHub mutation/read path and preserve typed rate-limit defer such as `deferred_rate_limited`; rate-limit or transport failure is not an empty candidate set or successful sweep.
<!-- governed-triage-item: confirm-receipt -->
- [x] **Confirm + receipt**: Clear pending/legacy triage labels only after the contract is satisfied, then apply the current `triaged:vN` stamp last when authorized and read it back. In addition, every substantive model-triaged run records additive model provenance using `triaged-by-<model>-<effort>` derived from authoritative execution receipts (never stripped on re-triage or correction). The single idempotent receipt records checklist completion, direction evidence, disposition, priority/effort/tier, actor-permission outcome, and any handoff. Pickup additionally requires fresh direction evidence. Cosmetic removal of `decomp-in-progress` never gates discovery or reuse.
<!-- governed-triage-item: taxonomy -->
- [x] **Taxonomy**: Validate the current DOCTRINE §14 causal taxonomy and, for defects, distinct prevention and detect/self-heal/recover ladders; conserve new actionable findings as durable work.
<!-- governed-triage-item: outcome-shaped-acceptance -->
- [x] **Outcome-shaped acceptance**: Confirm 'Durable fix and acceptance' states binding acceptance criteria (each names a real consumer or the evidence that stands in for one) rather than a prescribed implementation, and that any implementation suggestions live only in 'Relevant details' as explicitly advisory. Rewrite a prescriptive body into this shape using skills/gh-issue-value-review's refresh-required procedure instead of restating it here.
<!-- /governed-triage-checklist -->
